pages.title: Mark the working area
pages.text: Place an Automation Field controller. Build a connected, closed border of Field Markers at the controller’s base height, touching the controller. The controller can be part of the border.$(br2)The field covers the markers and their enclosed interior, including the bottom layer. Leave the inside free for nodes and machines. Set the height in the controller’s hologram to reach the upper nodes.

pages.title: Connect two chests
pages.text: $(li)Put an $(item)Output Item Node$() on the source chest.$(li)Put an $(item)Input Item Node$() on the destination chest.$(li)Set matching item filters on both nodes.$(li)Supply the controller with both fluxes.$(br2)An Output Node takes items out of its chest; an Input Node puts items into its chest.

pages.title: Start small
pages.text: Set the Output Node’s batch size to 1 for your first transfer. Put matching items in the source and leave room in the destination.$(br2)The default Whitelist mode needs samples on both nodes. An empty whitelist allows nothing; an empty blacklist allows everything.$(br2)Keep the nodes themselves inside the border, even when mounted beside their inventories. A gap in the border leaves the interior uncovered. Enable the outline display to check the field’s overall bounds.
